Virtues: Conviction and Instinct

Followers (Albigensians/Gnostics) hold a dualist view of Light and Darkness at war, and consider vampires the perfect servants of Darkness. They indulge every vice and tempt mortals into corruption, believing private sin matters less than leading others to fall.

Hierarchy of Sin (most to least severe):

  1. Failing to sin gloriously or indulge the senses when the opportunity arises
  2. Failing to lead another into temptation when the chance presents itself
  3. Failing to embrace and strengthen passionate mortals for Darkness
  4. Resisting or denying the destiny that made you what you are

Typical followers: social-focused vampires; favors Dominate, Presence, Chimerstry, Animalism.
